blocks.raw: # Displaying prices and information
blocks.text: Displaying prices and information

blocks.raw: ## Asset details
blocks.text: Asset details

blocks.raw: Every asset on the DriveWealth platform has associated fundamental and general information data. These data points can allow investors to make more informed decisions, or help platforms ingest typical asset components such as a company logo.
blocks.text: Every asset on the DriveWealth platform has associated fundamental and general information data. These data points can allow investors to make more informed decisions, or help platforms ingest typical asset components such as a company logo.

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Data best practices

  Most fundamental data is updated on a daily basis and should be stored in cache to limit the total number of requests to the instrument's endpoint. General information such as logo and prospectus links that do not update frequently can be stored for longer.
</Callout>

blocks.raw:
<Callout icon="📘" theme="info">
  ### Logo query parameters

  Every logo allows for customization through hosting on [imgix](https://imgix.com). For example, to render a logo and adjust its size, it’s possible to add `/fit=crop&w=300&max-h=300` to the image URL.
</Callout>

blocks.raw: ## Quotes and prices
blocks.text: Quotes and prices

blocks.raw: DriveWealth APIs carry pricing data for Equities, Mutual Funds, and Fixed Income securities.
blocks.text: DriveWealth APIs carry pricing data for Equities, Mutual Funds, and Fixed Income securities.

blocks.raw: Equities data is split into different data feeds for retrieving the prices of assets:
blocks.text: Equities data is split into different data feeds for retrieving the prices of assets:

blocks.raw:
| Market data option         | Coverage                                              | Price                   | Typical use                                                                     |
| :------------------------- | :---------------------------------------------------- | :---------------------- | :------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Referential Feed           | Equities (listed, core session, includes OTC), Crypto | Per customer, per month | Display data prior to and on execution for non-US Clients / Customers           |
| Consolidated Exchange Feed | Equities (listed, core+extended sessions)             | Per request             | Display data prior to a customer submitting a trade, and prior to its execution |
| 15 Minute Delayed Feed     | Equities (listed, core session)                       | Free                    | Watchlist and symbol searches                                                   |

blocks.raw: A user must first be successfully created in order for a customer to be shown the market data. This is required because DriveWealth has a reporting requirement to the exchanges for who is accessing the data.
blocks.text: A user must first be successfully created in order for a customer to be shown the market data. This is required because DriveWealth has a reporting requirement to the exchanges for who is accessing the data.

blocks.raw: All market data endpoints require that the `userID` of the customer who is being provided the quote is passed as a parameter within the header of the API call being made; as shown below.
blocks.text: All market data endpoints require that the userID of the customer who is being provided the quote is passed as a parameter within the header of the API call being made; as shown below.

blocks.raw:
```javascript
GET /back-office/quotes/AAPL
dw-customer-user-id: {userID}
```

<Callout icon="🚧" theme="warn">
  ### Storing data

  DriveWealth does not allow redistribution or non display of market data, meaning: clients may not store any data received for further use within their infrastructure.
</Callout>

blocks.raw: You’ll notice above that there are multiple numbers that can be used to represent the single “price” of a security. For most assets, these 3 values are important in different contexts:
blocks.text: You’ll notice above that there are multiple numbers that can be used to represent the single “price” of a security. For most assets, these 3 values are important in different contexts:

blocks.raw:
* `bid` — Shown at the time when a sale is being contemplated by customer
* `ask` — Shown at the time when a buy is being contemplated by the customer
* `lastTrade` — Displayed as a primary price of the asset elsewhere in the experience
